description: This file contains unit test cases for the ModelCatalogLoader in a Swift project, specifically testing the parsing and sorting of model data from TypeScript source code and handling cases with no exported data.

classes.name: ModelCatalogLoaderTests
classes.description: A struct containing test functions for validating the model catalog loader functionality.

methods.name: `load parses models from type script and sorts`
methods.description: Asynchronously tests that the loader correctly parses, sorts, and filters model data from a TypeScript source string.

methods.name: `load with no export returns empty choices`
methods.description: Asynchronously tests that the loader returns an empty list when the source code contains no exported models.
